content.title: Reach a distinct administrative banking dashboard as admin_user
content.intent: Prove that admin_user lands in the intended administrative experience and that it is distinguishable from the ordinary customer-facing dashboard.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the documented admin_user persona; applied auth/permission because the dashboard is role-aware after authentication; applied state/flow because the path starts at successful login and ends in the authenticated destination view. Risk gate implied strength=3 because auth applies, but no combinatorial input matrix was needed because the persona is the single outcome-changing input.
